video_title: Stephon Castle on Staying Connected on Defense Against the Lakers

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on the necessity of discipline when guarding Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: the biggest thing is discipline. He plays at his own pace, it's hard to speed him up.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing is discipline. He plays at his own pace, it's hard to speed him up. So when he gets to certain spots on the floor, if you're not disciplined, that's where he really hurts you with drawing and-ones, picking off corners, just little stuff like that. But it's also not a one-on-one thing. We have to play great team defense, so when we've had success against him in the past, I think we've done that.
quotes.social_post: Stephon Castle on guarding Luka Doncic: The biggest thing is discipline. He plays at his own pace and it is hard to speed him up. If you are not disciplined, that is where he really hurts you.

structured.context: Stephon Castle discusses the defensive discipline required to guard Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on his versatility alongside Luka Doncic and Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: keeping the versatility in my game, not trying to hone into one skill, but trying to be elite.
quotes.quote: I think the biggest thing is the last thing you said, just keeping the versatility in my game, not trying to hone into one skill, but trying to be elite at a lot of different ones. It's definitely a big deal to be in the same conversation as those two guys for sure.
quotes.social_post: Stephon Castle on being mentioned alongside stars like Luka Doncic and Jayson Tatum: It is definitely a big deal to be in the same conversation as those two guys for sure.

structured.context: Stephon Castle reflects on being mentioned in the same conversation as Luka Doncic and Jayson Tatum.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on his focus as a lead guard for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: just trying to produce good shots for us. Most times when you're the only guard on the floor.
quotes.quote: Just trying to produce good shots for us. Most times when you're the only guard on the floor and you have to create the action sometimes or create the advantage sometimes, most times you don't get the assist out of it. But I think the process of it and the flow of our offense, when we're focused on the right things, I think it goes pretty well.
quotes.social_post: Stephon Castle on his role as a lead guard: Most times when you are the only guard on the floor and you have to create the advantage, you do not get the assist out of it. But I think the process of it goes pretty well.

structured.context: Stephon Castle describes his role and focus as a lead guard for the Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on the timing required for a perfect pass to shooters
quotes.excerpt: when your shooter is expecting the ball, you want to try and get it to them.
quotes.quote: I think just on time, on target. The best way I can put it is when your shooter is expecting the ball, you want to try and get it to them at that time while they're ready to shoot. So I think a lot of it is the timing of it and where the ball is at, how long they were open for. Just all those little things kind of play into it and just getting our guys the right type of shot.
quotes.social_post: Stephon Castle on his passing philosophy: The best way I can put it is when your shooter is expecting the ball, you want to try and get it to them at that time while they are ready to shoot.

structured.context: Stephon Castle explains the importance of timing and accuracy when passing to teammates.
